aliases_observed.notes: The Green Man calls Rand this, hinting at his destiny

characters.notes: The Green Man identifies Rand as 'Child of the Dragon.' Rand experiences a relief from burning points in his bones upon entering the Green Man's domain.
Perrin hangs back, uneasy about the Green Man's words. His eyes shine yellow and fierce when confronted by the Forsaken, consistent with his wolf connection.
Mat expresses a desire to see the Tree of Life. He is thrown back by Aginor's power and wields the dagger from Shadar Logoth when trying to defend Nynaeve.
Egwene attempts to use her untrained Power against Aginor but is held rigid by the effort. Rand pulls her to safety. She wears flowers in her unbound hair.

factions.name: Women's Circle
factions.notes: As Wisdom of the Two Rivers

characters.notes: Nynaeve attacks Aginor with a knife in defense of Lan, is seized and lifted by Balthamel, causing her extreme pain. She is tossed aside and left limp. Later placed by the oak tree that grows from the Green Man's sacrifice.

stable_traits.physical_traits: no more than shoulder high to any man there

characters.notes: Moiraine explains the Eye of the World and its purpose. She confronts Aginor with the Power, creating a chasm of flame, but is overwhelmed and begins to scream.

Lan draws his sword to defend against the Forsaken but hesitates to position himself between Moiraine and Nynaeve. He is thrown back by Aginor's power and struck against the stone arch, falling unconscious.

stable_traits.physical_traits: tall, there would have been room enough for him in the corridor
stable_traits.filiations: son of Arent son of Halan

characters.notes: Loial expresses wonder about the Eye of the World, having read about it. He flees when Moiraine commands everyone to run.

stable_traits.physical_traits: towering figure made of vines and leaves, hazelnut eyes, scar on his body, green fingers
stable_traits.age: ancient, set to guard the Eye over three thousand years ago

characters.notes: The Green Man guides the group through his forest garden, makes flower garlands, tends plants. He refuses to enter the Eye of the World, sensing his end is linked to it. He dies defending the group from Balthamel, and an oak tree grows from his sacrifice as his tomb.

stable_traits.physical_traits: older than old, skin like crazed parchment drawn tight over skull, wispy tufts of brittle hair, withered ears like scraps of ancient leather, sunken eyes, yellowed fanged teeth, gnarled fingers lacking a fingernail
stable_traits.age: ancient, imprisoned for three thousand years

characters.notes: Aginor is one of the Forsaken, freed from his prison at Shayol Ghul. He seeks the Eye of the World and identifies that he has found what he needs. He displays immense power, throwing Lan back and creating a barrier against Mat and Perrin. He walks through Moiraine's flames.

stable_traits.physical_traits: head and face completely covered by tight black leather carapace worked into a perfect face of a young man laughing wildly and insanely
stable_traits.age: ancient, imprisoned for three thousand years

characters.notes: Balthamel is one of the Forsaken, freed from imprisonment. He no longer speaks with his tongue. He seizes Nynaeve by the face, lifting her and causing her great pain. He is killed by the Green Man, who crushes him and causes plants to grow through and consume his body.
Rand's horse, referred to as the bay throughout the chapter. Rand leads Red through the forest.
Ba'alzamon is mentioned when Rand hears Aginor's voice and momentarily believes it is Ba'alzamon speaking.

aliases_observed.notes: Aginor mentions Ishamael as one who walks the world again

characters.notes: Aginor mentions that like Ishamael, he and Balthamel now walk the world again. This confirms Ishamael is also freed from imprisonment.
Aginor states there will be no Lews Therin Kinslayer or Lord of the Morning to save them this time.

aliases_observed.notes: the common name for this tree

characters.notes: The Green Man mentions he has not rested beneath Avendesora's branches in two thousand years. This is the Tree of Life that Mat wanted to see. It is not at this location.

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World in the Blight
appearances.notable_actions: Leads his horse Red through the forest, follows the Green Man to the Eye of the World, enters the chamber containing the Eye, backs against the wall in fear of the pool, flees when Moiraine commands, tackles Egwene to stop her from attacking the Forsaken, throws a rock at Aginor to protect Egwene, runs when Aginor pursues
appearances.demeanor: Initially relieved and lighter in step upon entering the Green Man's domain, then increasingly fearful and protective, especially of Egwene

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Hangs back from the group, enters the Eye of the World chamber, backs against the wall in fear, readies his axe when the Forsaken appear, attempts to attack to save Nynaeve but is thrown back by Aginor's power
appearances.demeanor: Wary, reluctant to hear more from the Green Man, fearful of the Eye, fierce and protective when fighting

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Asks to see the Tree of Life, kicks a stone into the Eye of the World and watches it dissolve, backs against the wall in fear, attempts to attack the Forsaken to save Nynaeve with his dagger from Shadar Logoth, is thrown back by Aginor's power
appearances.demeanor: Curious initially, then uneasy and fearful, brave in attempting to defend Nynaeve

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Wears flowers in her hair, smiles at Rand, enters the Eye chamber and clutches Nynaeve in fear, attempts to help Nynaeve when the Forsaken attack, is tackled by Rand, runs into the trees, attempts to wield untrained Power against Aginor
appearances.demeanor: Initially serene and peaceful in the Green Man's domain, becomes fearful at the Eye, then determined and angry when trying to fight Aginor

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Wears flowers in her hair and braid, expresses concern about the danger, screams when Lan is hurt, attacks Aginor with her knife, is seized by Balthamel who lifts her by the face causing extreme pain, is thrown aside and left limp, is placed on the roots of the oak that grows from the Green Man's sacrifice
appearances.demeanor: Initially peaceful, then angry at Moiraine's plan, becomes fierce and protective when Lan is hurt, suffers greatly at Balthamel's hands

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Receives a flower garland from the Green Man, leads the group to the Eye of the World, explains the nature and purpose of the Eye, commands the group to run when Aginor appears, attacks Aginor with the Power creating a chasm of flame, attempts to hold him but is overcome and begins to scream
appearances.demeanor: Commanding, knowledgeable, determined, shows strain when wielding Power against Aginor

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Accompanies Moiraine, questions the appearance of Aginor and Balthamel, draws his sword to defend, hesitates between protecting Moiraine and Nynaeve, is thrown back by Aginor's power and struck against the stone arch, falls unconscious
appearances.demeanor: Cautious, protective, momentarily hesitant, then incapacitated

appearances.whereabouts: The Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Follows the group, expresses wonder about the Eye of the World having read about it, begins to invoke the Light's protection when seeing the Forsaken, flees into the trees when Moiraine commands
appearances.demeanor: Curious, scholarly, fearful when confronted by the Forsaken

appearances.whereabouts: His forest domain containing the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Guides the group through his forest garden, tends plants as he walks, makes flower garlands for Nynaeve, Egwene, and Moiraine, refuses to enter the Eye chamber because his end is linked to it, confronts Aginor and Balthamel when they appear, grapples with Balthamel and causes plants to grow through and consume him, dies from burns inflicted by Balthamel, transforms into an oak tree marking his tomb with Nynaeve resting on its roots
appearances.demeanor: Gentle and nurturing in his domain, protective and fierce when defending against the Forsaken, accepting of his fate

appearances.whereabouts: Emerges from the trees in the Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Appears with Balthamel, identifies himself, points at Mat calling him an old friend and old enemy, declares he and other Forsaken are freed, throws Lan back with a gesture, creates a barrier that throws Mat and Perrin back, dismisses the Green Man contemptuously, walks through Moiraine's flames, pursues the fleeing group
appearances.demeanor: Contemptuous, powerful, focused on the Eye of the World, cruel and dismissive of opposition
alliances_shown: the Great Lord of the Dark

appearances.whereabouts: Emerges from the trees in the Green Man's domain near the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Appears with Aginor wearing a leather mask, stands silently, leans toward the Eye of the World, seizes Nynaeve by the face and lifts her causing extreme pain, tosses her aside, is grappled by the Green Man, attempts to burn the Green Man with his hands, is killed when the Green Man causes plants to grow through and consume his body
appearances.demeanor: Silent, menacing, sadistic in his treatment of Nynaeve, struggles desperately against the Green Man

appearances.notable_actions: Is led by Rand through the forest
Mentioned by Aginor as walking the world again
Referenced by Aginor as not being present to save the world this time

appearances.whereabouts: Not at this location; the Green Man has not been beneath its branches for two thousand years

relationships.description: Moiraine is the Aes Sedai who holds the Warder bond with Lan
Rand is protective of Egwene, vowing to keep her safe; Egwene smiles at him and they share an affectionate moment
Nynaeve screams and attacks the Forsaken when Lan is hurt, showing deep concern for him
Both are Forsaken who arrive together and work in concert
The Green Man fights and kills Balthamel to protect his domain and the group
Moiraine confronts and attempts to stop Aginor with the Power
They travel together as friends from the Two Rivers
They travel together as friends from the Two Rivers
They travel together as friends from the Two Rivers and fight together
The Green Man recognizes Moiraine as Aes Sedai and has kept faith with the charge given by Aes Sedai long ago; he gives her a flower garland
Rand owns and leads his horse Red
